description: Fixed benchmark dataset for release campaign. Compares legacy, agent-led, and autonomous-local workflows across quality, performance, and deterministic-integrity metrics.
evaluation_set_note: This dataset is the evaluation set. Do not tune workflow parameters against it without preserving a separate held-out set.

objectives.title: Local LLM embedding model comparison
objectives.objective: Compare the quality and performance of ONNX embedding models (nomic-embed-text, bge-m3) versus OpenAI embeddings for semantic retrieval in the firecrawl_skill codebase.
questions: Which ONNX embedding model achieves the best recall on the firecrawl_skill retrieval corpus?
What is the latency difference between ONNX and OpenAI embeddings on CPU?
Does embedding dimension mismatch cause Qdrant index failures?
expected_unresolved_controversies: ONNX model quality may be adequate for retrieval but inferior to OpenAI for semantic reasoning

objectives.title: Coverage-led vs page-count research completion
objectives.objective: Evaluate whether coverage-led research completion (issue #67's predecessor work) correctly identifies when research is sufficient versus relying on successful page counts.
questions: Does the orchestrator stop when coverage is complete even if page targets are not met?
Does the orchestrator prevent completion when coverage is incomplete even if page targets are exceeded?
Are adaptive cycles properly authorized by coverage gaps?
expected_unresolved_controversies: Coverage gaps may not capture all semantic dimensions of the research objective

objectives.title: EvidencePacket v1 citation binding
objectives.objective: Verify that EvidencePacket v1 correctly binds claims to evidence passages, supports corroboration/contradiction groups, and prevents invented citations.
questions: Can the packet validator detect invented citations?
Are corroboration and contradiction groups properly populated?
Does the report validator ensure every claim resolves to exact packet passages?
expected_unresolved_controversies: Some claims may be partially supported — the system must distinguish supported from unsupported

objectives.title: Resource governance and endpoint health
objectives.objective: Evaluate the local resource governance system (issue #66) for concurrency control, token/batch caps, endpoint health tracking, and backpressure handling.
questions: Does the governor enforce token and batch caps?
Does endpoint health tracking prevent calls to unhealthy endpoints?
Does backpressure correctly limit concurrent semantic calls?
expected_unresolved_controversies: GPU is reserved for local LLM; embedding/reranker run on CPU with high latency

objectives.title: Lease-safe embedding microbatching
objectives.objective: Verify that embedding microbatching (issue #65) correctly manages lease ownership, handles partial batch failures, and prevents false job completion.
questions: Does each microbatch maintain lease ownership?
Does partial batch failure not falsely complete jobs?
expected_unresolved_controversies: Lease expiry during long-running batches may require restart
